name: How do I prepare my home for a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do before construction starts on a whole-home renovation to avoid delays and damage?
mainEntity.text: What should I do before construction starts on a whole-home renovation to avoid delays and damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparation is one of the easiest ways to reduce stress once construction begins. Clear out furniture, wall art, clothing, kitchen items, and anything that could be damaged by dust or vibration. Decide where items will be stored and how workers will access the home. Confirm whether utilities will need to be shut off and when. Finalize long-lead selections such as cabinetry, tile, lighting, appliances, and plumbing fixtures so procurement can begin on time. It also helps to create a list of items that must be protected, removed, or relocated before demolition. The more complete your preparation, the less likely the project is to stall during the first few weeks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a whole-home renovation starts, remove belongings, create a storage plan, confirm access routes, protect valuables, set utility shutoff plans, and finalize selections that have long lead times. Good preparation helps the project start cleanly and avoids schedule delays.
